name: Balloon Party
bio: Archetype: AoE Healing, DEF Buff, Damage Reflect. ⌽ Applies [Balloon of Innocence] to team for DMG Reduction/Heal-on-hit ⌽ Applies [Party Balloon] for damage reflect. ⌽ Most damage comes from [Party Balloon]; relies partly on Ult for buffs. ⌽ Flexible defensive support; pairs well with Arcanists that have a lot of HP (Nautika, Semmelweis, etc.) ⌽ Minimal investment required to be effective. ⌽ Heals get stronger with lower HP, cannot heal to max HP.
